review_title: NLP4PBM: A Systematic Review on Process Extraction using Natural Language Processing with Rule-based, Machine and Deep Learning Methods
generation_note: Five yes/no questions derived to cover Stage 1 observable eligibility: explicit NLP-for-process-extraction signals, input/output linking to natural-language text and process representations, common non-target tasks, clear survey/review status, and ambiguous/incomplete abstract evidence that should be deferred to Stage 2.

questions.question_text: Does the title or abstract explicitly state the paper uses natural language processing (NLP) to extract or construct process models or process representations from natural-language text?
questions.coverage_note: Directly tests required inclusion: explicit NLP for process extraction from natural-language text (maps to Stage1 required criteria 1 & 2).

questions.question_text: Does the title or abstract indicate that the input is natural-language text (e.g., instructions, documents, descriptions, narratives) and the output is a process-model or process representation (e.g., process graph, BPMN, event sequence) or equivalent process structure?
questions.coverage_note: Checks observable task linkage between natural-language input and process-model/representation output (maps to Stage1 required criterion 2).

questions.question_text: Does the title or abstract clearly indicate the study is about a non-target task (e.g., process redesign/matching/prediction, sentiment analysis, per-label classification unrelated to extracting process structure, or generating natural text from processes) rather than extracting process models from natural-language text?
questions.coverage_note: Detects exclusion examples listed in Stage1 exclusion criteria (non-target tasks) so papers can be deprioritized or excluded at Stage1.

questions.question_text: Does the title or abstract clearly identify the paper as a survey, review, or other secondary research (not original empirical work)?
questions.coverage_note: Identifies secondary research explicitly indicated in title/abstract, which Stage1 exclusion criteria list as excluded.

questions.question_text: Does the title or abstract provide incomplete or ambiguous evidence (e.g., mentions NLP or process terms separately but does not explicitly connect NLP methods to extracting/constructing process representations), such that eligibility should be deferred to full-text checking (Stage 2)?
questions.coverage_note: Captures the guidance to mark 'maybe' and defer when core fit is plausible but title/abstract evidence is incomplete (maps to Stage1 required criterion 3).
